description.value: A private resort on Highway 5 just north of Valemount with tent sites along Swift Creek, where you fall asleep to rushing water beneath Rocky and Cariboo Mountain peaks; most sites are full-hookup RV slots and this is a paid commercial operation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Swift Creek Resort is an active campground and cabin resort on 26 acres just north of Valemount, BC. It has 25 campsites (18 with water/electricity/sewer hookups) plus tenting sites beside Swift Creek, and three cabins. Phone and website match between OSM and the website. The address differs in road naming: OSM says '60 Southern Yellowhead Highway' while the website contact page says '60 N Highway 5' — these are the same road (Highway 5 is the Southern Yellowhead Highway). Reservations are confirmed via the 'Book Now' tab. No specific mention of hiker/biker sites, showers, laundry, cyclist discounts, or most other amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: Address naming discrepancy: OSM uses '60 Southern Yellowhead Highway' while the website contact page uses '60 N Highway 5, Valemount, British Columbia'. These refer to the same road (Highway 5 = Southern Yellowhead Highway).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground with tent sites on the Yellowhead Highway corridor near Valemount — a logical overnight stop for touring cyclists crossing the BC Rockies.

wow_evidence: tent sites along Swift Creek...no specific mention of hiker/biker sites, showers, laundry, cyclist discounts
